about_the_game:
The game is still in early development, play test builds may not feature all the features listed in the store page.

Start your very own Anime Coffee Shop Today!

Kissaten Dream is a coffee shop management game where you'll handle the day-to-day operations of your own Japanese coffee shop. Your journey begins hands-on, manually grinding beans, and brewing each cup of coffee to perfection. As your profits grow, you can reinvest in your business by purchasing upgrades to enhance your shop. Different customers of various backgrounds will patronise your shop, find out what makes them tick, and perhaps go the extra mile to solve issues bothering them.

Purchase an automated grinder, upgrade to a state-of-the-art espresso machine, or even set up self-checkout kiosks for customers. With your dedicated assistant, Ayame, by your side to help you build a successful business, you have everything you need to succeed.

Manage your shop, setup your equipment

Setup your equipment, stock up on supplies, keep your business running.

Brew some coffee and serve your customers

Sit back, relax, and engage in the different parts of the coffee brewing process.

Complete requests and get rewarded

Some customers may have certain requests you can complete to receive unique rewards.

Features

☕ Decorate your dream coffee shop: Design your shop's interior by placing tables, seats, and decor to create a relaxing, retro atmosphere.

☕ Brew a variety of coffee: Master the craft of coffee brewing. Manually grind your beans, learn new recipes, and use various brewing methods like the V60 Dripper, Espresso Machine, and Moka Pot.

☕ Upgrades to improve your workflow: Begin your journey by doing everything yourself. As you progress, invest in better equipment to make your life much easier.

☕ Serve a vibrant clientele: Encounter a variety of unique customers, each with their own quirks. Go the extra mile, and help them with their problems.

☕ Manage your business: It's not all about coffee! Budget wisely to pay your bills, restock supplies to keep your business up and running.

short_description: From hand-grinding beans to designing the perfect layout, every detail is in your hands. In Kissaten Dream, you serve a cast of unique customers, manage your business, and transform your humble coffee shop into a beloved local gem.
